scenes.source_prompt: A photorealistic shot of a young adult at a Japanese train station ticket gate. A red error light is flashing and the gate barriers are closed. The person has a panicked, apologetic expression. Right next to the person's head is a clean white speech bubble containing the exact Japanese text "えっ、嘘...". Highly detailed, candid street photography, realistic Japanese everyday life.
scenes.prompt: Photorealistic single-panel Japanese everyday-life scene, 16:9 landscape. Morning rush hour at an unmistakably Japanese automatic railway ticket gate: compact blue-grey gate units, IC card reader, closed red paddle barriers, tactile yellow paving, commuters queuing behind. An ordinary young Japanese adult has just tapped an IC card and been stopped, turns back slightly toward the waiting queue with a small startled apologetic expression, no forced bitter smile. Clearly readable display on the gate says 残額不足. Make the closed gate and reader visually obvious and physically plausible. Eye-level side three-quarter view shows the character, gate and short queue in one instantly understandable composition. Natural station lighting, everyday clothing, realistic proportions and skin, no fashion model styling. One large clean white speech bubble with black outline near the character's head, tail clearly points to that character, containing exactly えっ、嘘… in bold readable Japanese. No other captions, logos or watermark. Do not show an extreme emotional performance.
